changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md`

- names `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Both marketplace chunks were held by CHUNK CO-TENANCY, not by any import of the page: rolldown had parked `components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` (statically imported by the eager `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) in the first, and `console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx` (bare-imported by the package barrel for its SDUI registration) in the second. An `app-shell-eager-leaves` group in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` isolates those co-tenants so the three declared-lazy pages chunk by their own dynamic-only reachability. The console eager closure moves 3180.2 KB → 3171.5 KB gzipped (−8,888 bytes, 48 → 45 eager chunks) with the three per-chunk ceilings unmoved.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `1263e405d` (merge-base with origin/main): 7 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1816 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2426 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36730942576)

## ✅ Console Performance Budget

| Metric | Value | Budget |
|--------|-------|--------|
| **Eager closure** (gzip, 330 chunks) | **3576.6 KB** | 3607.4 KB |
| Main entry chunk (gzip) | 149.7 KB | 350 KB |
| Entry file | `index-CJk48ASU.js` | — |
| Status | **PASS** | — |

The **eager closure** is every chunk the entry reaches through static imports — what the browser fetches and parses before the app renders. The entry chunk on its own is a small fraction of it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `384d81e7349a5b5f9ac35c21c3faae72435f0445`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#11201 (body; comments `5909828367`, `5910404448`, `5910537969`, `5912136282`, `5913605784`, `5913610243`), PR #11225 (body, 8 files, the diff against `main` at merge-base `0389650f3`), and the head's 43 check-runs, read 2026-09-30T14:55Z: 40 `success` (Test shards 1–8, Test, Test (dist pins), Type Check, Lint, Build & E2E, Spec Main Shape Gate, Changeset Bump Policy / Declaration / Claim Re-read / Fixed Group Check / Overwrite Report, and the rest), 3 `skipped` (coverage ×2, dependabot), 0 failed, 0 in progress. Base and objectstack context read as blobs at objectui `0389650f3` and objectstack `1741c5dcb`; nothing built, run or re-run. Rendered 2026-09-30T15:00Z.

### ① Derived judgments

**Producers (step 1), each against ruling B.** Every nav-entry write site at the merge-base (a `git grep` of `objectName:` / `dashboardName:` / `pageName:` / `reportName:` / `viewName:` and of `navigation:` writers over `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src`, tests excluded):

1. Console sync, `newPageNavigationItem` / `newDashboardNavigationItem` (`useNavigationSync.ts:52–72`): `...(label ? { label } : {})` at base, label-less since objectui#9868; `NavigationSyncEffect` is the only in-tree caller and passes no label. Unchanged, newly pinned. Right.
2. Studio Create app, `buildAppSkeleton` fed by `loadPackageObjects`: base `label: o.label` with `o.label ?? o.name` and `d.name` upstream; now `{ id, type: 'object', objectName }`, and `AppNavSeed` is `{ name }` only. Right.
3. Studio bind, `StudioNavItemInspector`: base `label: isPlaceholder && obj ? renamedLabel(label, obj.label, locale) : label`; now `bindObject` deletes `label` when `isPlaceholder` and the label is absent or a plain string. Right (the bind reading is below).
4. App wizard, `generateNavFromObjects`, fed by `CreateAppPage.tsx:30` and `EditAppPage.tsx:67` (`label: obj.label || obj.name`, `pluralLabel: obj.pluralLabel`): base `label: o.pluralLabel || o.label`; now `generatedEntryLabel`, a label only for a declared plural that spells neither `o.label` nor `o.name` (trimmed, case-insensitive). Both pages reach it through `mergeNavWithObjects`; the pin drives `CreateAppPage`, and `EditAppPage` shares the function. Right.
5. Correctly left alone, since none writes the target's text: `AppNavCanvas.addItem` (`t('engine.appNav.newItem')`, id `nav_item_N`), `NavigationDesigner.newNavItem` (`label: labelFor(type)`), the wizard's own `addNavItem` (`New Group` / `New Link`, group and url only), `AppNavInspector`'s picker (`patch({ objectName: v, object: undefined })`, no label written), `renameNavigationItems` (rewrites `pageName` / `dashboardName`, never `label`). `DashboardDesignPage.tsx:47` is the dashboard document's own `label` on the `!dashboard` branch that early-returns before any save, not a nav entry, as the dev read it. The other `objectName: current.name` sites in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (3695, 3843) are `object-view` / `object-form` schemas. **No producer is missed.**

**The wizard's declared-plural exception, the reading.** Stage 1's letter is "an ABSENT label for a standard entry, never the target's machine name". `generatedEntryLabel` refuses a plural that spells `o.name` or `o.label`, so it never writes the machine name and never writes the copy inheritance would show: within the letter. Against the one rule: the plural is a present label, so it renders verbatim, follows no rename of `pluralLabel`, and localises only through an id-keyed bundle entry (`apps.APP.navigation.OBJECT.label`, the wizard's id being the object name) or an inline map. That was already true at base: a plural differs from the machine name, so the retired guard's `isCustomized` was true and rendered it verbatim, and this PR changes nothing about it; what it removes is the singular copy. Inheritance has no plural rung (`inheritedNavItemLabel`: view label, object label, machine name), so the alternative, never writing it, would change every wizard-created list entry from `Projects` to `Project`, which stage 1 was told not to do ("Display does not change"). My reading: within ruling B's stage 1, and no reliance on the retired guard. What remains is a real but pre-existing class: a platform-written present label that is not a machine name, distinguishable by signature (id equals `objectName`, label equals the object's `pluralLabel`). It belongs to stage 2's conversation (a plural rung in the spec's inheritance, or the wizard preferring inheritance), not to this diff. The dev carried it as "承接者:无 · Acceptance notes only"; I would give it a pointer in the census / stage-2 routing rather than none. The seat decides.

**The bind: does it ever delete an author's label?** `dropLabel = isPlaceholder && (label === undefined || typeof label === 'string')`; `isPlaceholder = !curLabel || curLabel === 'New item' || curLabel === t('engine.appNav.newItem', locale)`. Deleted: a plain-string label that is `''`, the English sentinel, or the designer-locale sentinel. Kept: any other string (pinned: `Clients`), and every map, even one whose designer-locale entry is empty or the sentinel; where the base wrote the object's label into that locale, the map is now left as authored, which is strictly more conservative, and the objectui#11148 pin (`label: ITEM_LABEL` under zh, kept on bind) still passes. The one author text that can be dropped is a label typed as literally `New item` or its translation, which the base overwrote with the object's label anyway, so nothing is lost that the base kept. `''` is a present label that renders empty (the sync's own docblock: "⛔ Never `''`"); dropping it on bind is the right outcome. **No.**

**Pins.** `useNavigationSync.standardEntryLocalizes-11201.test.tsx` drives the real `NavigationSyncEffect`, reads the entry back from `saveItem`'s call (`not.toHaveProperty('label')`), then renders that stored entry through `NavigationRenderer` wired as `UnifiedSidebar` wires it (`useObjectLabel` resolvers plus `useNavTargetLabel`) under a real `I18nProvider` whose zh-CN bundle is loaded through `isSpecTranslationData` / `transformSpecTranslations`: `Pipeline Health` under en, `管道健康` under zh-CN. That is the ruling's pin as written. `StudioDesignSurface.standardNavEntries-11201.test.tsx`: seeded entries carry no `label`, `AppSchema` accepts the skeleton, en renders `Account` and `draft_thing`, zh-CN renders `客户`; binding a `New item` placeholder leaves no own `label` and the entry parses through `NavigationItemSchema`; a typed label is kept. `AppWizard.standardNavEntries-11201.test.tsx` drives the real `CreateAppPage`, parses the saved body with `AppSchema`, and pins the three label-less cases and the `Accounts` control. `createConformance.test.ts` seeds names only. Each producer has its pin. The ablation legs A to D each hit exactly the pins that guard the mutation; leg A's zh-CN staying green is what the guard does: at base `resolveNavItemLabel` finds a machine-name label not `isCustomized` and hands it to `resolver(item.objectName, base)`, the bundle, which is precisely why stage 1 keeps the guard, and that green is not counted against the pin. Right.

**The census (step 2), as a reading.** The method is sound: a TypeScript-AST walk of `navigation: [...]` literals and their `children`, applying the guard's own test, over a population enumerated at the ref it reads. The population checks: `git grep -l "navigation: \["` at objectstack `1741c5dcb` over `examples` and `packages/platform-objects` names the same seven files (crm, multi-package core, showcase, todo; account, setup, studio). A regex read over those seven blobs (no AST, nothing run) finds the same 39 object- or dashboard-targeted entries the guard reads (6+1+20+6+6+0+0) and the same single hit: todo `nav_overdue`, `viewName: 'overdue'`, `label: 'Overdue'`, an author's. The NOT MEASURED rows are honest and correctly reasoned: production needs production data; a seeded console was not booted, and a fresh seed stores the packaged apps already counted while the sync writes nothing without user CRUD; `apply_blueprint` is NOT READABLE (the cloud repo answers 403), with its declared contract quoted right, `BlueprintNavItemSchema.label`: 'Nav entry label (defaults to the target label/name)' (`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts:189`). "Can the row tell writers apart" answers the ruling's question, and answers it in the shape the ruling's stage-2 fork needs: no recorded provenance per entry (a strict object, no stored inherited flag) or per row (`sys_metadata` columns describe the document's last write); the sync's `nav_page_` / `nav_dash_` epoch-ms id is a strong heuristic, the Studio's `nav_` plus name and the wizard's id-equals-name are weak ones; history does not separate the sync, the Studio and the wizard from the signed-in user. That is the material triage routes stage 2 on, including its "back to the maintainer" branch. Sound.

**The twin check (step 3).** Read at objectstack `1741c5dcb`, `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`. `translateApp`'s walk: `if (typeof node.id === 'string') { const translated = lookupNavLabel(bundle, appName, node.id, opts); if (translated) next.label = translated; }`. `lookupNavLabel`: `pickData(bundle, code)?.apps?.[appName]?.navigation?.[navId]?.label` for each `code` of `localeChain(opts)`. Nothing reads `objectName`, `viewName` or `dashboardName`; nothing compares a label's text. Id-keyed only: **not a twin**, and it is one of the two routes the execution note keeps. Right.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `11201-standard-nav-entries-label-less.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`, `@object-ui/plugin-designer: patch`, both in the fixed group; Changeset Bump Policy, Fixed Group Check, Declaration and Claim Re-read are all `success`. Exported surfaces: the app-shell index exports `StudioDesignSurface` (props unchanged), `useNavigationSync` and `NavigationSyncEffect` (unchanged); `skeletons.ts` (`AppNavSeed`, `buildAppSkeleton`) and `StudioNavItemInspector` are not on it (the inspector's docblock says so; the skeleton's importers at base are `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and two tests). The plugin-designer index exports `AppCreationWizard`, `CreateAppPage`, `EditAppPage` and `NavigationDesigner`; `generateNavFromObjects` is module-private and `AppCreationWizardProps` is unchanged. What moves is the stored document these components write (no `label` on a standard entry, which the spec accepts), rendering the same text: a fix. Patch is right. **`Clause-②: no` is right**: no schema, prop, type or accepted set on an exported surface moves, and stored entries are not converted. No exported surface moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions: []`. Each deviation and out-of-scope note, answered:

1. **The serial constraint: landing first is a user-visible regression, so the ACCEPT holds landing until objectui#11196 (PR #11224) is on `main`.** At base the Studio Interfaces rail (`NavTree`: `labelText || surface?.name`) shows a label-less object entry by its MACHINE NAME (`account` where `Account` was shown), the Studio canvas (`AppNavCanvas`) shows the positional `Item N` row for a truly absent label, and the wizard's Navigation step (`resolveKeyedI18nLabel(item.label)`) shows a blank row. Before this PR each of those surfaces showed the stored copy, in the very flows this PR changes: Create app with add-objects, the bind, the wizard. The runtime sidebar is unchanged. #11196 at `d78e28afd` (PR #11224) makes the rail (`navEntryLabelText(node, locale, targetLabel)` with `useNavTargetLabel`), the canvas, the inspectors and the wizard's step (`resolveNavItemLabel(item, …, targetLabel)` with `labelOf` built from `draft.objects`) draw the inherited text.
